sources: http://www.cityofrosiclare.com/Services.html (read 2026-11-16): 'Rosiclare Riverside Campground | Riverwalk | Boat Docking Facility ... Located in the Rosiclare City Park, there are 12 campsites provided with water and electricity (50 and 30 amp service), firewood and a dump station. Exciting News...we now have Wi-Fi at our campsites!! For only $21 a night ... Our rates are also discounted if you stay over 7 days.. .the normal rate of $21 a night drops to $18 a night, but only if you stay 7 nights or longer. For more information about the campground, call 618-285-3445 or 618-926-4640'; 'On the opposite side of the park below the campground are boat docking facilities available to everyone.' Esri World Imagery hw 200 m at the pin and z19 tiles at 37.4180,-88.3442 (viewed 2026-11-16): the town sits behind a grassed levee; the campground is on the river side of it - about 12 angled back-in pads off the lane along the levee foot (37.4176-37.4187, -88.3452 to -88.3437). Their river ends abut a gravel strip and a large paved day-use lot (boat-dock parking with a painted helipad), then the bank; nearest water ~45-55 m from the pad ends

note: City of Rosiclare campground beside the city park, on the river side of the town levee: the sites look across a paved boat-dock lot to the Ohio River, about 50 m away. Boat docks, river walk and playground next door; Garden of the Gods and Cave-in-Rock are a short drive. Call ahead the day you arrive. --Claude
summary: City of Rosiclare services page and imagery read. $21 (7+ nights $18), 12 sites, 50/30-amp + water, dump confirmed (manual); Wi-Fi added. Riverview KEPT after a hard check (pads ~45-55 m from the Ohio across a paved day-use/boat-dock lot; campground riverward of the levee). Booking (fcfs, call ahead) not on the operator page, left derived. Note cleaned.
